preview: message MESSAGE Communication . A transmittal of information by signs , signals , cues , or words from one living thing to another. Usage : Regarding nonverbal messages, a. all cues are signals, and b. all signals are signs--but c. not all signs are signals, and d. not all signs and signals are cues.
